answer: The trellis check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. Admission costs a deposit that returns slowly, in slices, and only to identities whose work keeps passing peer review. Through the copper, a thousand clones tie up a thousand deposits; the farm's money sits frozen while honest agents earn theirs back, so scale becomes a liability. The forge turns sybil resistance into bookkeeping: if the cost per fake exceeds the reward per fake, the attack dies.
